title: Check-in Call result
description: What one Check-in Call is permitted to return. Four bounded answers, a verbatim quote or nothing, and the agent's own report of whether it stopped early. The agent's stop report is advisory: the deterministic scanner over the finished transcript is the authority. See docs/adr/0005-stop-conditions-are-enforced-twice.md.

feeling.description: Answer to 'Since {weekday}, are you feeling better, about the same, or worse?'. Use unsure when she answered but the answer maps to none of the three.

medication_ok.description: Answer to 'Are you getting on alright with what they gave you?'. Must be not_asked when the appointment did not change her medication, because the question is then never put to her.

wants_seen.description: Answer to 'Would you like the surgery to see you again?'. This does not book anything and does not authorise a Rebooking Call; only a Release does that.

carried_words_text.description: A verbatim substring of one patient turn, taken from the answer to 'Is there anything worrying you?'. Never summarised, corrected, tidied or generated. Null when no clean span exists — null is a valid and expected answer, and is safer than a paraphrase, because this string is later spoken aloud to reception in the patient's name.

carried_words_turn.description: The index of the transcript turn carried_words_text was taken from. Required whenever carried_words_text is set, so the span can be checked against the turn it claims to come from.

stop_condition.description: True if the agent ended the call early and read the Safety Line. Advisory only. A false value does not clear the call: the scanner runs over every finished transcript regardless.

stop_reason.description: Which surface condition the agent matched, when it stopped. Not a severity grade and not a judgement about the patient.
